Important Information
l       The "Available Credit Limit" shown in this statement takes into account charges incurred but not due. Please ensure that at least the "Minimum Amount Due" reaches us by the "Due Date".
l       Maintain a healthy credit status: Pay atleast minimum amount by the due date, or within 3 days after, to avoid Defaulter status with Credit Information Companies.
l       If the minimum amount due or part amount less than the total amount due is paid, interest charges are applicable (including fresh purchases, if any) on an average daily reducing balance method.
l       If you miss paying the undisputed minimum amount due within 3 grace days from the due date the bank will report the default to credit information companies and other regulatory / statutory
        authorities as per prevalent regulatory requirements, laws and directions.
l       Effective 15th May 2026, Product Features, Fees & Charges on your credit card will be revised. Please refer to the MITC / product webpage for details.
l       To Hotlist your credit card, login into Netbanking, please click here or call our phone banking numbers.
l       Making only the minimum payment every month would result in the repayment stretching over months/years with consequential compounded interest payment on your outstanding balance. The level
        of unpaid amount of the bill i.e., part payment beyond 'minimum amount due', at which the interest-free credit period benefits would not be available to cardholders.
l       When the card member receives communication from Bank regarding a refund from the merchant for a transaction incurred kindly call Phone-Banking @ 1800 1600 / 1800 2600 to issue DD or to obtain an
        update on the refund. Customers travelling overseas can reach out to +9122 61606160.
l       To know the Voluntary Codes as prescribed by the "The Banking Codes and Standards Board of India (BCSBI)", please click here
l       How to read GST entry in your Credit Card statement:
